answers.why: One line per question, with its status today.
answers.security: Where do prompts and files go?
To your gateway and nowhere else. Your header makes the browser enforce it.
built
What can code the AI writes reach?
Nothing outside its sandbox: a worker with an opaque origin and no network.
built
What stays on laptops?
Each person’s work, sealed with AES-256-GCM. Policy can require a passkey or password lock.
built
Can the AI read client names and card numbers?

Not those you hide. People’s names in English, French, German and Spanish, and your policy’s lists and patterns, leave the device as marks, put back in the answer. Masked, not anonymous: what nothing finds goes as it is.
key
Is every action logged?
Each turn, brain call and tool use goes to your OpenTelemetry collector. Your gateway’s log stays the authoritative one.
key
How do we trust a release?
Releases are signed and come with a CycloneDX bill of materials, checked with OpenSSH.
built
Does it follow ANSSI’s guide?
Each of its 35 recommendations for generative AI is mapped in the trust pack: what {name} does, what is left to you, what isn’t built.
built
Has it been tested from outside?
Not yet. The brief for the test is published.
not

Whatever your size, never per seat: the audit export and retention, long-term support releases, filled-in security questionnaires, the outside test’s report, help to set up, and a copy hosted at your address if you want one.
price.note: What needs no key is open source, under MIT. A key unlocks every version released before its end date, forever, and {name} checks it offline.
faq.title: Questions
faq.items: How is it different from a per-seat assistant or a self-hosted chat?

A per-seat assistant runs in its vendor’s cloud, on its vendor’s models. A self-hosted chat means app servers, a database and storage to run. {name} is a static folder: nothing to operate, any model, and no price per seat.
Can it sit alongside Microsoft 365 Copilot?
Yes. It serves the people without a Copilot licence, on any device with a browser, and reads and writes Microsoft 365 through your own app registration.
Can it run without the internet?
With your gateway on premises and the header limited to it, nothing leaves your network. On a capable computer, {name} can also answer on the device.
Can we put our name on it?
Yes: your name and colours, and your own privacy page and terms.
